reviews.summary: Provided Reviewed-by tags for all three patches in the series, indicating approval without raising any specific technical concerns or suggestions.

2026-11-17.patch_summary: This patch series aims to simplify the get_page_from_freelist function in mm/page_alloc by introducing cleanups and consolidations of vmscan and page_alloc code. The primary goal is to make the function easier to read, especially after recent kswapd zone skip conditions were introduced.
